row:
Hello,

We are a group of animal rescue volunteers who have main jobs but love to spend an extra time trying to do something good. Our goals to share rescue abandoned, homeless, neglected, stray dogs (and other animals) from the streets or from local terrible shelters... treatment and give for them our warm care and love and finally find for them a forever home.

Our headquarter is in Blanchardstown, Dublin but our network/volunteers are around the world. We don't receive donation via our headquarter, but donation please send directly into our volunteers/partners which we always put link and information in the video description.

If you love dogs/animals or have any case need our help. Please contact us at the email below: dublinworkinghard@gmail.com

Thank you so much!
